actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.call.SipDeviceServices.find#SipDevices').requireNewTransaction(true).disableAuthz().call() || {} const errors = ec.message.hasError() ? ec.message.errorsString : null ec.message.clearErrors() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({errors, deviceList: out.deviceList || [], domain: out.domain || null, sipPort: out.sipPort || null, tlsPort: out.tlsPort || null, transport: out.transport || null, registrarEnabled: !!out.registrarEnabled})
